payload.title: Build opt-in E5 retrieval and measure downstream agent quality against Markdown controls
payload.description: Read-only compact-intent and heading-aware document retrieval prototype; frozen three-arm downstream coding benchmark on new synthetic domain projects with honest retained failures and equivalent source information.
acceptance: Opt-in local pinned E5 retrieval exposes bounded source candidates with current hashes/status, two channels, exact section citations and no identity/status mutation; default install does not load Python or download models.
Meaningful tests cover source/path bounds, untrusted input, cache/source updates and deletions, output budgets and live pinned inference.

Freeze public tasks, held-out score checks, prompts, model/settings/order/deadlines and source fingerprints before scored agent calls; all arms see equivalent facts and failures are retained without scored retries.

Run six matched triples across three new domain fixtures in English/Hebrew: good Markdown search, Markdown plus identical E5, DIP structured memory plus E5. Score code correctness, version/deferred/identity recovery and tool/token/time costs, not retrieval alone.

Publish raw sanitized artifacts and causal replay, report synthetic/one-model/small-sample and incomplete attribution limitations; configured checks pass, intent reflects completion or remaining blockers.
